title: Old Saxon / Old Low German Universal Dependencies corpus
summary: Machine-readable historical-language syntax corpus preserving Old Saxon / Old Low German forms and syntactic annotation.
semantic_integrity: Original forms and normalized/annotated representations must remain distinguishable; historical language identity is not collapsed into modern German.

title: Sea Ice Extent & Concentration v2, 1850–present
summary: Versioned sea-ice record combining historical observations with modern satellite observations, preserving a long observational lineage.
semantic_integrity: Historical observations, reconstruction methods, and satellite-derived measurements are distinct evidence layers; version changes are preserved rather than treated as overwrite.
canonical_identifier: NSIDC Sea Ice Extent & Concentration v2

title: IMP-6 LANL 2-minute plasma data
summary: Legacy spacecraft plasma measurements including temperature anisotropy and alpha/proton ratio with persistent SPASE identity.
semantic_integrity: Instrument identity and measurement cadence are retained as provenance; later derived products must not replace the original observation layer.

title: TOLNet / NOAA Chemical Sciences Laboratory lidar observations
summary: Lidar atmospheric observations spanning 2015–2026 with persistent NASA identifier and instrument lineage.
semantic_integrity: Observation, calibration, processing, and derived atmospheric products are tracked as separate layers.
provenance: NASA Earthdata / NOAA Chemical Sciences Laboratory

title: Sentinel-1D Single Look Complex SAR observations
summary: 2026 Sentinel-1D SAR observation lineage supporting Earth-surface, glacial, tectonic, and geomorphic analysis.
semantic_integrity: Acquisition identifiers and processing lineage are preserved so future derived analyses can be distinguished from source observations.

title: Harvard University Herbaria: All Records
summary: Digitized specimen records stewarded by Harvard University Herbaria, spanning former component collections and a global specimen base exceeding five million physical specimens.
semantic_integrity: Historical collection identities remain distinguishable; digitized occurrence records are not treated as equivalent to the physical specimen.

title: Multilingual Cloud Corpus of Bangladesh
summary: National-scale multilingual corpus covering 42 language varieties with 85,792 structured entries and approximately 107 hours of annotated audio; 14 varieties are described as endangered.
semantic_integrity: Language varieties are preserved as documented varieties; translation, IPA transcription, and English/Bengali stimulus material are distinct evidence layers.

title: Boletim da República de Moçambique — Cold Archive
summary: Cold archive of 13,541 distinct PDF artifacts with 13,248 resolved publication references and 45 unresolved identities preserved separately.
semantic_integrity: Unresolved publication identities and conflicting metadata are retained rather than silently resolved; extracted text remains derivative of the source PDF.

title: NIR-SORT textile spectroscopy and microscopy dataset
summary: Known-provenance and real-world textile measurements spanning benchtop and handheld NIR instruments plus optical microscopy, with machine-readable metadata and uncertainty documentation.
semantic_integrity: Specimen provenance, instrument identity, transformed measurements, and model outputs remain separate layers.

title: Trinity College Dublin Herbarium
summary: 85,651 herbarium specimen records published as a Darwin Core Archive with monthly updates.
semantic_integrity: Occurrence records remain linked to specimen context and collection identity.

title: Bhutan National Herbarium specimen records
summary: Newly registered Bhutan National Herbarium specimen datasets published through GBIF with Darwin Core source archives and multiple identifiers observed.
semantic_integrity: Multiple GBIF registrations are tracked by DOI and source archive rather than collapsed solely by title.

title: Vittorio Marchesoni's Herbarium
summary: Historical herbarium from the Sibillini Range, collected 1948–1963, purchased by the University of Florence in 1963 and physically transferred there in 2018; a duplicate is held elsewhere.
semantic_integrity: Collection custody and duplicate-series identity are preserved as separate provenance facts.

title: PRA Herbarium Dataset
summary: Institute of Botany of the Czech Academy of Sciences herbarium dataset, version 1.4, published September 22, 2026.
semantic_integrity: Dataset version and specimen record identity are retained independently.
provenance: Institute of Botany of the Czech Academy of Sciences

title: Organological databases and repositories — critical source catalogue
summary: Critical catalogue and structural atlas of 53 registered organological source keys plus constituent score collections and audit-only resources, with dated evidence register.
semantic_integrity: The catalogue explicitly distinguishes source keys from constituent collections and preserves source dependence and editorial responsibility.

title: Trait-record scientific references v2
summary: Versioned 8.7 MB TSV dataset of scientific works cited by trait records, released as Zenodo v2.
semantic_integrity: Reference identity is preserved as a separate evidence layer from the trait records that cite it.

title: U.S.-Wide Sentinel-2–USGS River Suspended Sediment Matchup Dataset
summary: 25,474 quality-passing Sentinel-2/USGS suspended-sediment matchups from approximately 1,170 monitoring sites across the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii.
semantic_integrity: Satellite observations, in situ measurements, matchup criteria, and quality flags remain separate evidence components.
